entries.name: PageLayout
entries.summary: Initial library choices for collection, detail, settings, and dashboard pages. PageHeader owns the heading and actions. PageLayout adds transparent region wrappers without page padding or child styling. ReadingColumn provides 55ch/65ch/75ch starting measures. ContentGrid uses a container-responsive maximum of one to four columns. Products can propose additional recipes through review.

document.purpose: Compose named page regions using four initial task-specific recipes, explicit reading measures and adaptive grids.

PageLayout.header: PageHeader owns title, description, actions, metadata, leading, back, breadcrumbs and heading props.
PageLayout.slots: header is generated from header props; children is main; filters, aside and footer are optional only where supported.
PageLayout.collection: Optional filters/footer; available width; no aside, reading measure or grid options.
PageLayout.detail: Optional labelled aside/footer; main then aside; no filters or page-level reading measure/grid options. Use ReadingColumn explicitly within main for prose.
PageLayout.settings: Optional footer and measure; one reading column; no filters, aside or grid options.
PageLayout.dashboard: Optional footer, maxColumns and minItemWidth; no filters, aside or page-level measure; direct children become grid items.

ReadingColumn.scope: Explicit prose/form region, not an entire collection or data grid.

ContentGrid.scope: Adaptive grid; maximum is a cap, not a forced count.

validatePageLayoutRecipe.input: JSON object with archetype and optional slots/measure/maxColumns/minItemWidth/asideLabel. Unknown keys fail.
validatePageLayoutRecipe.returns: Array of structured issues; empty means this selection is supported.
validatePageLayoutRecipe.slotValidation: When slots are supplied, header/main are required; duplicates and unsupported slots fail; a detail aside requires a nonempty label. Omitting slots does not assert actual rendered content exists.
validatePageLayoutRecipe.excluded: Does not validate React nodes, DOM semantics, visual quality, data state, route completeness, keyboard workflows or accessibility of nested content.

invariants: Use the same shared PageHeader implementation through every PageLayout recipe.
Named regions follow header, optional filters, main, optional aside and optional footer order.
Collection results use available width and preserve their own scrolling and toolbar behavior.
Only the initial detail recipe allows an aside; main and aside form at most two regions and stack in that order in narrow containers. This is not a universal two-column limit.
Settings use an explicit readable measure; dashboard grid caps are one through four and adapt to the available container.
The shell owns page padding. PageLayout adds no surface, routing, persistence, fetching, selection or form state.
Each nested shared component retains its own style tokens and interactive behavior.
The consuming application owns the document main landmark, data states and actual task semantics.
limits: These four recipes are an initial library, not an exhaustive classification of pages. Unsupported tasks may require another reviewed recipe.
Reading measures are starting points, not universal readability guarantees.
Configuration validation cannot replace browser interaction, geometry, accessibility and visual review.
No human approval or stable release is implied by experimental registry discovery.

contract.raw:
{
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "id": "page-layout",
  "version": 1,
  "status": "experimental",
  "verification": "recipe-selection-validation-is-not-rendered-or-human-certification",
  "purpose": "Compose named page regions using four initial task-specific recipes, explicit reading measures and adaptive grids.",
  "anatomy": ["header", "filters?", "main", "aside?", "footer?"],
  "exports": [
    "PageLayout",
    "ReadingColumn",
    "ContentGrid",
    "pageLayoutRecipes",
    "validatePageLayoutRecipe"
  ],
  "importPath": "@dimitriszoitas/aegis-agentic/patterns/page-layout",
  "tokenGroup": "page-structure",
  "behaviorProvider": "native-structure-with-existing-PageHeader; application-controls-own-behavior",
  "recipeSource": "src/patterns/page-layout/recipes.ts",
  "portableRecipes": "recipes/page-layout.json",
  "guidance": "skills/references/page-composition.md",
  "publicApi": {
    "PageLayout": {
      "required": ["archetype", "title", "children"],
      "archetypes": ["collection", "detail", "settings", "dashboard"],
      "header": "PageHeader owns title, description, actions, metadata, leading, back, breadcrumbs and heading props.",
      "slots": "header is generated from header props; children is main; filters, aside and footer are optional only where supported.",
      "collection": "Optional filters/footer; available width; no aside, reading measure or grid options.",
      "detail": "Optional labelled aside/footer; main then aside; no filters or page-level reading measure/grid options. Use ReadingColumn explicitly within main for prose.",
      "settings": "Optional footer and measure; one reading column; no filters, aside or grid options.",
      "dashboard": "Optional footer, maxColumns and minItemWidth; no filters, aside or page-level measure; direct children become grid items."
    },
    "ReadingColumn": {
      "measure": ["compact", "comfortable", "wide"],
      "default": "comfortable",
      "scope": "Explicit prose/form region, not an entire collection or data grid."
    },
    "ContentGrid": {
      "maxColumns": [1, 2, 3, 4],
      "defaultMaxColumns": 4,

entries.name: TokenInput
entries.summary: Enter and remove multiple free-text values with atomic per-value validation and controlled host confirmation.

document.purpose: Enter and remove multiple free-text values with atomic per-value validation and controlled host confirmation.
invariants: A committed value is trimmed, Unicode NFC normalized and nonempty. Duplicate identity uses JavaScript lowercase after normalization.
Enter or Add commits; Shift+Enter inserts a newline. Blur commitment is off unless explicitly configured.
Newlines and tabs separate batch values. Commas remain literal unless comma is explicitly a commit key.
Every invalid batch is atomic: no values change and the exact submitted draft remains editable, including line breaks.
Duplicate reject is the default. Explicit ignore skips duplicates and announces their count.
Blank commit is a no-op. Validator accepts null/undefined; a nonempty string rejects; exceptions and other return types reject safely. Validators are synchronous.
In values confirmation mode a draft clears only when the host echoes the ordered requested values. This mode suits synchronous parents.

Asynchronous parents use request confirmation: accepted acknowledgment must match requestId AND requested ordered values; rejected acknowledgment preserves the draft. Stale acknowledgments never settle a newer request.
The host owns committed values and must honor the supplied AbortSignal when work is cancelled. This component cannot undo an authoritative stale host write.
Editing and restoring draft text still counts as a new draft. A delayed acceptance does not clear newer edits or steal focus.
Pending controls block additional mutations; draft remains editable. Keep editing aborts the pending request.
IME composition, native isComposing and keyCode229 prevent commit/removal. Holding Backspace does not remove values.
Empty-input Backspace arms removal; a second distinct press removes. Escape, blur or editing cancels the arm.
Suggestions are named buttons, preserve unrelated draft, and never restrict free-text entry. This is not a combobox.
Removal controls have accessible names; disabled state prevents user mutations.
document.asyncHostRequirement: Use confirmationMode=request and correlate acknowledgment IDs; discard results whose request signal is aborted.

contract.raw:
{
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "name": "Aegis authenticated shared workspace protocol",
  "basePath": "/api/aegis-workspace",
  "deployment": "single-host-local-filesystem",
  "defaultPort": 4178,
  "authentication": {
    "scheme": "Bearer",
    "transport": "Authorization header only",
    "storage": "SHA-256 token hash",
    "roles": ["admin", "owner", "operator", "viewer", "ingest"],
    "expiryRequired": true
  },
  "requestRules": {
    "maximumBodyBytes": 65536,
    "maximumRequestsPerMinutePerConnectionAddress": 240,
    "unknownFields": "reject",
    "queries": "reject",
    "mutations": { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Aegis-Client": ["console", "sdk"] }
  },
  "endpoints": [
    {
      "method": "GET",
      "path": "/healthz",
      "relativeTo": "service-root",
      "authentication": false,
      "response": "minimal readiness only"
    },
    {
      "method": "GET",
      "path": "/projects",
      "role": "read-capable",
      "response": "scoped projects and actor label/role"
    },
    {
      "method": "POST",
      "path": "/projects",
      "role": "admin",
      "body": ["id", "name", "kitDigest", "profile"]
    },
    { "method": "GET", "path": "/kits", "role": "admin" },
    { "method": "GET", "path": "/audit", "role": "admin" },
    { "method": "GET", "path": "/maintenance", "role": "admin" },
    { "method": "POST", "path": "/maintenance", "role": "admin", "body": { "action": "resume" } },
    { "method": "GET", "path": "/projects/:id/status", "role": "scoped-reader" },
    { "method": "GET", "path": "/projects/:id/configurability", "role": "scoped-reader" },
    { "method": "GET", "path": "/projects/:id/generations", "role": "scoped-reader" },
    { "method": "GET", "path": "/projects/:id/audit", "role": "scoped-reader" },
    {
      "method": "POST",
      "path": "/projects/:id/plan",
      "role": "scoped-operator",
      "optionalBody": ["useAI"]
    },
    { "method": "POST", "path": "/projects/:id/reconcile", "role": "scoped-operator", "body": [] },
    { "method": "POST", "path": "/projects/:id/retention", "role": "scoped-operator", "body": [] },
    {
      "method": "POST",
      "path": "/projects/:id/telemetry",
      "role": "scoped-operator",
      "body": ["enabled"]
    },
    {
      "method": "POST",
      "path": "/projects/:id/usage",
      "role": "admin-or-scoped-ingest",
      "body": ["events", "batchId"]
    },
    {
      "method": "POST",
      "path": "/projects/:id/updates",
      "role": "scoped-owner",
      "body": ["expectedRevision", "kitDigest", "profile"]
    },
    {
      "method": "POST",
      "path": "/projects/:id/rollback",
      "role": "scoped-owner",
      "body": ["generationId", "expectedRevision"]
    },
    {
      "method": "POST",
      "path": "/projects/:id/activate",
      "role": "scoped-owner",
      "body": ["planId", "planDigest", "expectedRevision", "reason"]
    }
  ],
  "invariants": [
    "kits verified before runtime import",
    "signed releases required by default",
    "prepared plans expire after 24 hours",
    "activation uses compare-and-swap revision and new generation",
    "activation disables collection and AI",
    "rollback is prepared then reviewed",
    "service never auto-activates updates",
    "no remote model calls from maintenance loops"
  ],
  "errors": {
    "400": "invalid request",
    "401": "missing, expired or revoked credential",
    "403": "role/scope/origin/host/client marker refused",
    "409": "integrity, revision, lock or validation conflict",
    "413": "body too large",
    "415": "not JSON",
    "429": "request budget exceeded"
  }
}
